name: fsx-windows-sla-optimizer
description: Diagnoses Amazon FSx for Windows File Server SLA and reopen problems - DFS namespace resolution failures, Active Directory trust and authentication errors, shadow-copy (VSS) storage exhaustion and scheduling conflicts, and repeating throughput-capacity warnings - and produces a ranked, read-only-safe remediation plan. Read-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP and a custom Windows-event-log or Active Directory MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SUN at 11:00 UTC
